/** A plan. */
export interface Plan {
	name: string;
	apply(step: string): void;
}

export type Steps = string[];

export enum Mode {
	Fast,
	Safe,
}

export class Planner implements Plan {
	name = 'x';
	apply(step: string): void {}
	static create(): Planner {
		return new Planner();
	}
}

export function build(): Planner {
	return new Planner();
}

export const limit = 3;
export const make = (n: number) => n;

namespace Inner {
	export function deep() {}
}

abstract class Base {
	abstract run(): void;
}

function* gen() {}
